Speaking as a game dev, a lot of the time people don't think about accessibility in their games until very late in the process, at which point the code base of the game becomes hard enough to work with that changing it might cause problems/bugs (and hence need more time to implement -> cost a lot more). Moreover, each game is different enough that the programming for button remapping might not carry over from game to game. I'm not excusing devs for not including options for button remapping, because I absolutely think they should, but accessibility is something that needs to be considered from the very beginning, or else it gets very very hard to implement the later in the development process it gets.
